title: Thermodynamic Non-Equilibrium and the Cross-Section of Equity Returns: A Gibbs Free Energy Decomposition — Replication Package
description: Replication code and derived-data aggregates for a study showing that the apparent positive relationship between idiosyncratic volatility (entropy) and returns in large-cap equity panels is a survivorship artifact, using a survivorship-corrected full-universe panel of 12,449 firms constructed from Sharadar SF1. Raw third-party fundamental data (Sharadar SF1) are not redistributed in this deposit; the derived-data directory contains only cross-sectional aggregates (regression coefficients, portfolio-mean returns, and summary panels). See README.md for full data-access terms and a table-to-script mapping.
notes: ORCID for the creator is not on file in this repository; add via the Zenodo web UI before publishing if available.
